articles.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
articles.summary: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.

articles.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
articles.summary: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

articles.title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
articles.summary: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark, especially in Ohio.
